identification: Mixed brass lot (barley-twist candlesticks, candelabra, Buddha, spelter boy, duck, bell, plaques, hook, toasting fork). Only item of note is a cast brass relief portrait plaque of Archbishop Daniel Mannix with name label, about 23 x 16cm, matching a known Melbourne souvenir plaque type. Brass strip tool stamped J.R.G.&S WD broad arrow 1955 is common military issue, little value. Rest is generic brass worth little.
